title: Illness Relief on Shortened Visits — Personal Services Plan Care Coordination Note
content:
A Personal Services Plan visit that ended short of its booked time shortly before the resident was admitted to hospital or a rehabilitation facility is treated as cut short by the illness that led to the admission. The relief rests on the absence recorded on the resident's assisted living residency under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.

## Rule

When an hourly charge for such a visit is re-rated: where the visit ended short of its booked time and the resident's assisted living residency records a hospital or rehabilitation absence that began no fewer than 0 and no more than 3 days after the visit date, the visit is treated as cut short by the illness that led to the admission and the visit's billable hours are multiplied by 0.5; where the visit ended short of its booked time and such an absence began more than 3 and no more than 7 days after the visit date, they are multiplied by 0.8; otherwise they stand unchanged. The billable hours are rounded to two decimal places half up only after this multiplication, never earlier.

- **Ended short of its booked time:** the delivered minutes recorded on the visit's order are fewer than its booked hours multiplied by 60.
- **Hospital or rehabilitation absence:** the absence reason recorded on the assisted living residency is a hospital stay or a rehabilitation facility stay.
- **Days after the visit date:** the absence start date recorded on the residency less the visit date, in calendar days; an absence starting on the visit date itself is 0 days after it.

## Ladder

| Visit ended short of booked time | Recorded absence | Absence began, days after the visit date | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Hospital or rehabilitation | 0 to 3 | 0.5 |
| Yes | Hospital or rehabilitation | More than 3, up to 7 | 0.8 |
| Yes | Hospital or rehabilitation | Before the visit date, or more than 7 | 1 (unchanged) |
| Yes | Any other reason, or none recorded | — | 1 (unchanged) |
| No | Any | — | 1 (unchanged) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical visit on 10 March, ended short, hospital absence on record)

| Absence began | Days after the visit | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 9 March | Before the visit | 1 |
| 10 March | 0 | 0.5 |
| 13 March | 3 | 0.5 |
| 14 March | 4 | 0.8 |
| 17 March | 7 | 0.8 |
| 18 March | 8 | 1 |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A visit booked for 3 hours ended after 90 minutes, with billable hours of 1.50, and a hospital absence beginning 2 days later is on the resident's assisted living residency: 1.50 multiplied by 0.5 is 0.75 hour. Had the absence begun 6 days later: 1.50 multiplied by 0.8 is 1.20 hours. With billable hours of 1.25 and the absence 1 day later: 1.25 multiplied by 0.5 is 0.625, rounded half up to 0.63 hour.
